5 of 6 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Total Rewards Benchmarking — Peer Group Refresh

The Total Rewards Benchmarking — Peer Group Refresh was a review of the company's compliance with the Internal Revenue Code. The committee reviewed the company's tax filings and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To declare: RESOLVED, that the Special Committee on M&A approves the 2019 annual report on Form 10-K for filing with the SEC.

Moved: Norzaidi Cantrell  •  Seconded: Benjamin Robertson
Vote: 4 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Call to Order and Roll Call

A special presentation on the Call to Order and Roll Call was delivered by Akiko Bolton, an external advisor from Bullseye Compensation Partners. The presentation benchmarked the company against 73 peers and identified several opportunities for improvement. The committee thanked the presenter and directed management to develop an action plan.

Motion

To approve for execution: RESOLVED, that the Special Committee on M&A shall enter into executive session to discuss confidential matters.

Moved: Akiko Bolton  •  Seconded: Gaylord Khumalo
Vote: 3 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  2 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Sales Compensation Plan for FY2019

The discussion on the Sales Compensation Plan for FY2019 was led by Dov Miranda. The committee reviewed the performance of the Bootcamp and Skills Training division in the 2 region. The results were deemed unsatisfactory, and the committee requested a detailed turnaround plan from management.

Motion

To approve for funding: RESOLVED, that the Special Committee on M&A shall enter into executive session to discuss confidential matters.

Moved: Akiko Bolton  •  Seconded: Gaylord Khumalo
Vote: 5 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 4
Crisis Management Plan Test Results

The committee considered the Crisis Management Plan Test Results, a proposal to adopt a new policy on trade secrets. The policy was approved and will be implemented company-wide.

Motion

To appoint: RESOLVED, that the Special Committee on M&A approves the minutes of the meeting held on 2019-02-24 as drafted and circulated.

Moved: Dov Miranda  •  Seconded: Norzaidi Cantrell
Vote: 4 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 5
IT General Controls (ITGC) Audit Results

Dov Miranda opened the floor for discussion on the IT General Controls (ITGC) Audit Results. The committee members had received the pre-read materials, including the analysis in Exhibit E. The conversation focused on the risk assessment and mitigation plan. Following the discussion, a member of the committee proposed a motion to adopt the recommendations with minor amendments.

Motion

To reconsider: RESOLVED, that the Special Committee on M&A accepts the report presented regarding the IT General Controls (ITGC) Audit Results, and directs management to implement the corrective actions identified therein no later than 2019-05-28.

Moved: Dov Miranda  •  Seconded: Gaylord Khumalo
Vote: 4 Yea  /  1 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
